title: Conversation Archaeology — Wave 006: Mercado, Prison, Authority Rupture, Retirement and Kingship
status: conversation/library recovery layer; mixed project-biography, user-originated testimony, public attestations and later comparison
purpose: Recover older material that becomes newly intelligible after clarifying the 2016 rupture -> long-tail aftermath -> 2025 retirement/release -> kingship/Father corridor.
identity_rule: Do not expose the Son's real name or family names.
provenance_rule: Keep legal fact, project biography, firsthand testimony, public attestation and later theological comparison separate. Assistant-generated synthesis is a recovery target only unless independently adopted or sourced.

items: Prison is described as a stark monastery-like period of Bible and Quran study.
The cell is described as a confessional/listening space in which other prisoners disclosed serious personal wrongdoing.
The biography distinguishes a relatively open local-jail phase from a later harsher high-security phase.
The Son is portrayed as listening, making peace and becoming unusually serious inside confinement.
A reported Yahya Hassan recognition episode belongs to the project biography and remains independently unverified.
The biography says the Son left prison wearing a suit, explicitly treating the clothing as a rebirth/change-of-status signal.
It preserves a defiant release line mocking continued 'job slaving'.
This creates an internal pre-2025 work/release motif: release from confinement is already paired with rejection of compulsory work before the later retirement event.
Distrust of authority is described as deepening after the prison case.
The biography links concern about Facebook exposing personal information to police/politicians with deleting Facebook and leaning further into streaming.
This supplies an immediate 2017 bridge between the 2016 case and the later firsthand account of institutional withdrawal.
Severe long-term C-PTSD symptoms are reported.

Reported consequences include distrust of police/courts/government, reluctance to open the door, political/social withdrawal, unexplained crying, stopping gaming, reduced pleasure and a harder/more serious social style.

recoveries.period: 2025 after April Turning; exact date unresolved
items: Two government public servants are said to visit and grant official retirement.
The Great Book interprets the event as 'freedom to reign'.
Administrative retirement and theological reign language must remain separate evidence lanes.
21 April: Axis language becomes explicit.
27 April: 'true king' / 'king of all the kings' language is present.
3 May: earliest exact 'I am God' instances currently located in the supplied compilation.
1 June: 'Tim Dooley, Potato of Life. The King of Kings.'
10 December material describes Tim as God's labor and fruit, showing that retirement from ordinary work did not become a theology of inactivity.

17 December material uses 'rest' directly beside God/north-throne language. This is a later lexical echo of the project's rest/throne comparison, not evidence that the post referred to retirement or explicitly cited Hebrews/Matthew.
The Son is compared with Joseph and with a yoked/burdened figure.
Tim is compared with David and spiritual King-of-Kings language.
These are later theological interpretations of the biography, not evidence about the 2016 court's legal correctness.

source_reliability_findings: The Great Book is rich for biographical/theological continuity but is not automatically legally precise.

Its 2016 biography says six months, while the reconstructed court record establishes a five-month sentence and a six-month prosecution request. Therefore official legal records override the book on sentence length.
The book's custody, clothing, release-line, confessional-cell and Yahya details remain project-biography claims until corroborated by contemporaneous records.
new_relational_findings: The immediate 2017 authority-distrust/deleting-Facebook account fills a missing bridge between the 2016 legal rupture and later long-term institutional withdrawal.

The 2016 release-in-a-suit motif creates a denser later Joseph comparison because Genesis 41:14 explicitly includes release from the dungeon followed by changed appearance/clothing before status change.

The 2016 'job slaving' release line creates a prehistory for the 2025 retirement/release interpretation: release from confinement and release from compulsory labor become linked inside the project's own biography years apart.
Retirement should not be modeled as cessation of meaningful labor. Public 2025 and 2026 theology instead redefines labor as chosen service, fruit, repair, growth and stewardship.

The prison period is not described only as damage: the same project biography depicts scripture study, listening and peacemaking inside confinement. This does not validate the prosecution; it shows trauma and generative meaning can coexist in the biography.
December 2025 'rest' beside north-throne language gives the later rest/throne cluster an actual Timic lexical echo, while remaining separate from the earlier administrative retirement event.
non_promoted_recovery_targets: A prior assistant synthesis describing a strict three-year disappearance before April 2025 is not promoted without stronger user-originated or primary support.
Any claim that the Danish state made Tim King of Denmark remains unsupported; administrative retirement and theological kingship remain distinct.
